name: Romagna Albana

known.via: English Wikipedia "Romagna Albana" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

blurb.text: A white wine appellation of Emilia-Romagna, made principally from Albana in Bologna, Forlì-Cesena and Ravenna, and including wine from raisined grapes.
